rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the physical features and layout of an area of land.

example.english: The terrain in this area is complicated, so be careful when hiking.
example.traditional: 呢區地形好複雜，行山要小心。
example.jyutping: ne1 keoi1 dei6 jing4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 haang4 saan1 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this when terrain means the ground or the earth's surface itself, rather than its shape or features.

example.english: The terrain is very slippery after the rain, so walk slowly.
example.traditional: 落雨之後地面好跣，行慢啲。
example.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6 dei6 min2 hou2 sin2 haang4 maan6 di1
